scope: Initial full-scene reference paintings for the layered-world production assets. Runtime assets and complete generation history are recorded in char/bg2/layered_worlds_v2.prompt.json.

concepts.akari: A suspended office where the departing coworker's seat remains opposite hers; unsent letters form returning bridges, inverted offices and rain frame two umbrellas.
concepts.koharu: A never-ending fan livestream seen from audience balconies, connected to her bedroom; Rei is only on the stream screen, with its chat column.
concepts.rei: A celestial virtual broadcast stage for her own voice and favorite book, with three warm listener bays; no live-action filming rig.
concepts.mina: Three friends' real rooms connected by fragile return bridges; her ideal of bringing everyone home is held together with ribbons while her own route is incomplete.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final production boss battle environment for the Japanese anime game Refrain. Redesign the supplied environment into this character's idealized but emotionally trapped mind-world, NOT a literal room renovation. Single opaque landscape image, approximately 1536x1024, 3:2. Existing art is a style/identity/motif reference, not a composition to copy. Premium hand-painted Japanese anime game background, bold architectural silhouettes, purposeful asymmetry, deep layered space, beautiful controlled lighting, clean cel-like shadow groups. No playable character, no foreground people, no UI, no captions, letters or numbers, no watermarks. The game draws characters and attacks above this painting. Central 65 percent must have muted low-contrast mid-dark surfaces and broad atmospheric space, still richly designed; concentrate strong detail and luminous accents in upper corners and perimeter, never a giant bright central focal point. Avoid luminous dots, confetti, particles, attack-like rings and bright rain streaks in the play area. No generic plants, random bookcases, ordinary city skyline, generic cathedral or empty gradient room. This must feel like an expansive boss WORLD, not a small empty room with a decorated wall.
Image 1: real office anchor. Image 2: Akari's amber hair, ivory/gold/navy uniform and cyan message ribbons, costume reference only; do not draw her. Canon: she longs for her departing coworker to stay, return her feelings, sit opposite her and walk home together; her mind-world has upward rain, desks/chairs falling toward the ceiling, unsent/cancelled messages, two umbrellas. Art direction: THE OFFICE WHERE NO ONE HAS TO LEAVE. A spectacular suspended office landscape above a deep rain-blue cloud ocean. At the far upper-right, a small warm amber sheltered island holds exactly two facing empty workstations, recognizable from the real office, protected by enormous folded ivory letter-paper canopy shaped in angular overlapping folds, NOT a wedding chapel. Sweeping ribbons of blank unsent letter sheets form architectural bridges and turn back toward that island, more entanglement than roads. At upper-left, large broken office floor slabs rise upside down, desk/chair silhouettes attached underneath; glass window mullions dissolve into suspended rain at the edges. Foreground lower corners hold large dark angular paper-fold ledges; paired yellow and navy closed umbrellas rest together at one left ledge. Broad middle is a deep atmospheric rainy gulf with subtle desaturated reflections, not a tiled empty floor. A few warm windows and amber seams at the very edge suggest the comforting illusion of mutual affection, while the route bends back on itself. Strong scale change, windborne folded architecture, dynamic diagonal composition. Restrained midnight blue and slate teal, ivory folded planes, amber/copper warm accents; keep the middle appreciably darker than the pale gold/white character sprite. No floating word labels, hearts, hearts as architecture, romantic partner, castle, plants or giant office towers.

Image1: former modest star stage motif, transform its scale and layout radically; remove bookshelves/plants/desk junk. Image2: Rei's virtual avatar costume white/violet/antique gold and large geometric star, motif reference only no character. Canon: independent VTuber hides her real voice behind a perfect smiling avatar; she wants listeners to stay and hear her favorite stories, rather than only value viewer counts. Art direction: A VOICE REACHING THE CONSTELLATIONS. An enormous open-air virtual broadcast stage at the edge of a deep ink-blue celestial sky with broad silky aurora haze, NOT a cloud ocean, seen diagonally across a broad dark blue stage toward upper-left celestial void. Large sculptural ivory and antique-gold five-point STAR architecture is asymmetrically broken into long elegant cantilevered arcs high along the top and right border, violet curtain ribbons unfurl into the sky. Curving silver-blue sound-wave ribbons are permanent architectural balconies receding to distant tiers, not luminous attack lines. Far upper-left a slim crescent audience gallery holds exactly three small softly warm rectangular seating bays, hinting the three listeners in the story, with many unlit bays beyond. At the lower-right perimeter an enormous half-open book becomes a stage wing, its broad layered pages fanning toward the sky with blank faces and a mint bookmark; she wants to talk about this book, NOT an artist's studio. A single integrated broadcast console and resting microphone barely visible at lower-left edge connect the dream to her craft, no real filming cameras or light stands. Broad central stage and distant celestial space are deep desaturated cobalt/indigo, with a large uninterrupted low-contrast shadow shape behind characters, sophisticated monumental scale. White/gold side accents with violet, no generic chamber walls, no mirrored symmetric concert hall, no star confetti, no thousands of bright stars, no central spotlight, no obvious sci-fi space station, no extra screens with faces.

Image1: Mina's existing glass/memory world style anchor, not a composition to duplicate. Image2: Mina's black/white ribbons, sea-glass eyes, maid guide identity motif only, do NOT draw her. Images3-5: three exact real places she is trying to guide her friends home to, use as tiny framed architectural glimpses only (office, Koharu bedroom, Rei streaming desk). Canon: digital guide Mina has carried all three friends' painful words and trapped herself; her ideal is that nobody is left behind and everyone can return, she herself also wants someone to help her home. Art direction: THE RETURN PATHS SHE HOLDS TOGETHER. A vast surreal dark still tidal basin beneath a canopy of gigantic folded black-and-ivory ribbon structures, an intricate but readable woven return-route network at the perimeter, NOT a library, gothic cathedral, throne room or tech server. Three distinct gently illuminated rectangular doorframe islands at upper-left, far rear, upper-right contain small identifiable glimpses of the three real rooms from references. Broad pale paper-and-glass ribbon bridges extend from those islands and converge toward a small warm exit at the distant horizon, but one nearer bridge is split open, showing her own missing way home. Foreground outer corners show finely layered dark glass/blank-message paper ledges held together by carefully tied ivory ribbon knots, no household clutter. The central 65 percent is a large deep charcoal teal reflecting-water gulf with quiet broad reflections, not detailed cracks, not a void gradient; glimpses of connected paths in hazy distance provide scale. High sweeping asymmetrical canopy, powerful silhouette, quiet rescuing light along edges, pale dawn peach only at far horizon. Gray ivory, midnight teal, ink violet. The whole world feels like an impossible shelter she keeps holding up for others, beautiful and burdened. No readable text or labels, no people inside doorframes, no maid mansion, no invented Mina home, no plants, no floating particles, no neon grid, no central glowing orb.
